description: Persist per-repo guidelines extracted from PR review feedback, after the user has read and approved the exact text (reviewed: true is required; the server shows the user the text and stores it only after they approve; refused when the host cannot show that form, and in unattended runs). Overwrites any existing guidelines for the repo. Content is capped at 8 KB. Requires Gist persistence — fails with GUIDELINES_NOT_AVAILABLE in local mode.

content.description: Markdown content extracted from past PR review feedback

reviewed.description: Must be true: the user was shown this exact content and approved it. Never set it on your own.

name: guidelines-store
